UserProgressDoc.title: UserProgressDoc
UserProgressDoc.description: Private progression state for a Star Wars Droid Tycoon player.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who owns this progression profile.

displayName.description: Optional friendly display name from Google profile.

completedAllTiersInCycle.description: Whether all 40 tiers in the active cycle are complete.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile document was last updated.

OwnedDroidDoc.title: OwnedDroidDoc
OwnedDroidDoc.description: A logged owned droid stack in the player's hangar.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning player.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the droid entry was first logged.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the droid entry was last updated.

SuperRebirthHistoryDoc.title: SuperRebirthHistoryDoc
SuperRebirthHistoryDoc.description: Immutable record of a completed Super Rebirth transition.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning player.

fromCycle.description: Cycle number before Super Rebirth (1 to 10000).

toCycle.description: Cycle number after Super Rebirth (1 to 10000).

fromPath.description: Path indicator before Super Rebirth (1 to 6).

toPath.description: Path indicator after Super Rebirth (1 to 6).

atRebirthTier.description: Completed Rebirth Tier reached before triggering SRB (0 to 40).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the Super Rebirth occurred.

CustomDroidDoc.title: CustomDroidDoc
CustomDroidDoc.description: A user-defined custom droid entry outside the built-in 101-droid roster.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning player.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the custom droid was added.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the custom droid was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user progression document storing SRB Rank, active Cycle, active Path, and current Rebirth Tier.

/users/{userId}/droids/{droidId}.description: Subcollection of owned droids logged by the player.

/users/{userId}/srbHistory/{entryId}.description: Subcollection of immutable Super Rebirth history records.

/users/{userId}/customDroids/{customDroi.description: Subcollection of custom droid catalog entries created by the player.
